title: 羚羊天然氣合成液體工程
subcategoryTitle: 氣體處理與高值副產品
summary: 羚羊天然氣合成液體工程是本課引用官方資料的真實工程背景。研究焦點為合成與精製之間的熱量回收介面；課程把公開可確認的地理與項目身分，和自行建立的物料、能量、庫存及故障診斷情境分開，要求學徒逐項提交計算、假設、驗證資料與適用範圍。
summaryEn: Oryx GTL is the real engineering context identified by the official source. The study focuses on heat-recovery interfaces between synthesis and product finishing, separating verified project identity and geography from authored material, energy, inventory and diagnostic scenarios. Learners submit calculations, assumptions, validation evidence and applicability limits.
scope: 本課以真實公開工程為情境，結合五個案例應用單元與五個明示共用的方法單元；原理與教學結構會跨課程重用。全部算例輸入均為合成教學假設，不代表場址實測、設計、保證或操作設定。任務為離線分析、守恆估算、資料檢核與失效推理，不是施工、開採、爆破、設備操作或作業許可。
scopeEn: Real public projects provide context for five case applications and five explicitly shared method units; physical methods and teaching structure are reused across courses. Every numerical input is a synthetic teaching assumption, not measured, design, guaranteed or operating data for the site. Tasks concern offline analysis, balances, data checking and failure reasoning, not construction, extraction, blasting, equipment operation or permits.
v31Focus: 合成與精製之間的熱量回收介面
v31FocusEn: heat-recovery interfaces between synthesis and product finishing

stages.title: 資源條件與系統邊界：羚羊天然氣合成液體工程
stages.titleEn: Resource conditions and system boundaries: Oryx GTL
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「分離回收率與產品純度：合成與精製之間的熱量」與「熱回收與公用設施：合成與精製之間的熱量」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Recovery and product purity — case 1" and "Heat recovery and utilities — case 2": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

quiz.question: 關於「分離回收率與產品純度：合成與精製之間的熱量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Recovery and product purity — case 1" is correct?
options: 回收率衡量目標物進入產品的比例，純度衡量產品中目標物的比例，兩者分母不同。
回收率就是產品純度，因此兩者數字一定相同。
只要熱量相等，不同溫度的熱就能百分之百互換。
optionsEn: Recovery measures the fraction of feed target reaching the product, whereas purity measures the target fraction within that product.
Recovery equals product purity, so their numerical values must match.
Equal quantities of heat at different temperatures can always be exchanged completely.
quiz.explanation: 回收率衡量目標物進入產品的比例，純度衡量產品中目標物的比例，兩者分母不同。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Recovery measures the fraction of feed target reaching the product, whereas purity measures the target fraction within that product. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 分離回收率與產品純度：合成與精製之間的熱量：機制與資源流程
steps.titleEn: Recovery and product purity — case 1: mechanism and resource flow
steps.objective: 說明「分離回收率與產品純度：合成與精製之間的熱量」如何決定「羚羊天然氣合成液體工程」的物料、能量、量測或環境功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Recovery and product purity — case 1” governs material, energy, measurement or environmental functions in “Oryx GTL”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 本工程研究問題是「合成與精製之間的熱量回收介面」。以羚羊天然氣合成液體工程作為地理與系統脈絡，本單元建立可驗證的教學假設；下列模型並非宣稱該場址採用相同設備尺寸、工況或流程。回收率衡量目標物進入產品的比例，純度衡量產品中目標物的比例，兩者分母不同。用進料量、目標物含量、回收率與產品總量建立雙重物料帳，即可看出提高回收並不必然提高純度；實際相平衡與設備限制不由這個整體守恆式決定。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The case question is heat-recovery interfaces between synthesis and product finishing. Using Oryx GTL as geographic and system context, this unit constructs a testable teaching scenario; it does not assert that the site has the same dimensions, conditions or flowsheet as the model. Recovery measures the fraction of feed target reaching the product, whereas purity measures the target fraction within that product. Their denominators differ. A dual material balance using feed, target content, recovery and total product shows why higher recovery need not improve purity; phase equilibrium and equipment constraints remain outside this overall balance. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

quiz.question: 依「分離回收率與產品純度：合成與精製之間的熱量」的模型 mproduct,target=F·x·R，教學假設，非場址設計值：假設分離流程回收到產品的目標物質量最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model mproduct,target=F·x·R for "Recovery and product purity — case 1", which value is closest to the teaching assumption, not site design data: target mass recovered to product in a hypothetical separation?
options: 540 kg/h
optionsEn: 540 kg/h
quiz.explanation: mproduct,target=F·x·R；代入 F = 10000 kg/h、x = 0.12 mass fraction、R = 0.9 fraction，得 1,080 kg/h（教學假設，非場址設計值：假設分離流程回收到產品的目標物質量）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: mproduct,target=F·x·R; with F = 10000 kg/h, x = 0.12 mass fraction, R = 0.9 fraction the result is 1,080 kg/h (teaching assumption, not site design data: target mass recovered to product in a hypothetical separation). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 分離回收率與產品純度：合成與精製之間的熱量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Recovery and product purity — case 1: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「分離回收率與產品純度：合成與精製之間的熱量」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Recovery and product purity — case 1” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：mproduct,target=F·x·R；代入 F = 10000 kg/h、x = 0.12 mass fraction、R = 0.9 fraction，得 1,080 kg/h（教學假設，非場址設計值：假設分離流程回收到產品的目標物質量）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 R 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: mproduct,target=F·x·R; with F = 10000 kg/h, x = 0.12 mass fraction, R = 0.9 fraction the result is 1,080 kg/h (teaching assumption, not site design data: target mass recovered to product in a hypothetical separation). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise R by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：R 增加 10% 時，結果變為 1,188 kg/h（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising R by 10% changes the result to 1,188 kg/h (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 1,080 kg/h（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 R 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 1,080 kg/h (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in R with an engineering explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「分離回收率與產品純度：合成與精製之間的熱量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Recovery and product purity — case 1"?
options: 量測時不必記錄環境溫度、負載與運轉模式，因為它們不影響結果。
物料帳有差額就能立即斷定有實體洩漏。
針對合成與精製之間的熱量回收介面，先寫出本單元需要但公開來源未提供的現場資料，再進行合成資料驗證。
optionsEn: Ambient temperature, load and operating mode need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Any balance residual immediately proves a physical leak.
For heat-recovery interfaces between synthesis and product finishing, first list the site data needed but not supplied by the public source, then validate synthetic data.
quiz.explanation: 針對合成與精製之間的熱量回收介面，先寫出本單元需要但公開來源未提供的現場資料，再進行合成資料驗證。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: For heat-recovery interfaces between synthesis and product finishing, first list the site data needed but not supplied by the public source, then validate synthetic data. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 分離回收率與產品純度：合成與精製之間的熱量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Recovery and product purity — case 1: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「分離回收率與產品純度：合成與精製之間的熱量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Recovery and product purity — case 1” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 針對合成與精製之間的熱量回收介面，先寫出本單元需要但公開來源未提供的現場資料，再進行合成資料驗證。逐項計算產品與尾流的目標物，檢查兩者總和等於進料目標物；另給產品總質量算純度，避免用回收率欄位冒充產品品質。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: For heat-recovery interfaces between synthesis and product finishing, first list the site data needed but not supplied by the public source, then validate synthetic data. Calculate target mass in product and residue and verify their sum equals target entering with the feed. Use a separate total-product mass to calculate purity instead of substituting the recovery column for quality. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：每個百分比都寫明分母，並交付可追溯的進料、產品與尾流表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: State the denominator of every percentage and submit traceable feed, product and residue tables.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：取樣偏差可讓高回收與高純度看似同時成立，流量帳則可能不閉合；應比較獨立樣品、混合代表性與全流程質量差額。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Sampling bias can make high recovery and high purity appear simultaneous while the flow balance fails. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 在「分離回收率與產品純度：合成與精製之間的熱量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Recovery and product purity — case 1" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 取樣偏差可讓高回收與高純度看似同時成立，流量帳則可能不閉合；應比較獨立樣品、混合代表性與全流程質量差額。
所有異常都是操作人員失誤，設計、製造與維護不需要檢討。
只要熱量相等，不同溫度的熱就能百分之百互換。
optionsEn: Sampling bias can make high recovery and high purity appear simultaneous while the flow balance fails.
Every anomaly is operator error, so design, manufacturing and maintenance never need review.
Equal quantities of heat at different temperatures can always be exchanged completely.
quiz.explanation: 取樣偏差可讓高回收與高純度看似同時成立，流量帳則可能不閉合；應比較獨立樣品、混合代表性與全流程質量差額。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Sampling bias can make high recovery and high purity appear simultaneous while the flow balance fails. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 分離回收率與產品純度：合成與精製之間的熱量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Recovery and product purity — case 1: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「分離回收率與產品純度：合成與精製之間的熱量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Recovery and product purity — case 1” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 取樣偏差可讓高回收與高純度看似同時成立，流量帳則可能不閉合；應比較獨立樣品、混合代表性與全流程質量差額。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「羚羊天然氣合成液體工程」的安全、交付、壽命或環境。
steps.instructionEn: Sampling bias can make high recovery and high purity appear simultaneous while the flow balance fails. Compare independent samples, mixture representativeness and the complete material residual. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, delivery, life or environment of “Oryx GTL”.

steps.instruction: 本工程研究問題是「合成與精製之間的熱量回收介面」。以羚羊天然氣合成液體工程作為地理與系統脈絡，本單元建立可驗證的教學假設；下列模型並非宣稱該場址採用相同設備尺寸、工況或流程。熱回收先受熱源可放出熱量與冷端可吸收熱量的較小者限制，還要保留溫差驅動。用兩側熱容量流率建立簡化上限，再乘教學有效度；這不是夾點分析或換熱器設計，不能僅把兩個總熱量相等就宣告可在所有溫度層回收。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The case question is heat-recovery interfaces between synthesis and product finishing. Build a simplified upper bound from heat-capacity flow rates and apply a teaching effectiveness. This is not pinch analysis or exchanger design: equal total duties do not imply recovery at every temperature level. knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 污堵降低有效度而旁通混合也會改變出口溫度；只憑一支溫度計不能區分，應以雙側流量與四個端點溫度重建熱平衡。
knowledge.textEn: Fouling lowers effectiveness while bypass mixing also changes outlet temperature. One thermometer cannot distinguish them; reconstruct the balance from both flows and all four endpoint temperatures.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

knowledge.title: 證據版本
knowledge.text: 2026-11-10：核對官方工程識別與公開情境；算例由作者設定為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: 2026-11-10: Primary project identity and public context reviewed; numerical examples are authored teaching assumptions.
